search_text: published ZDI-20-925 ZDI-CAN-10332 (0Day) IBM Informix bts_tracefile Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-07-28 7.5 AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['IBM'] ['Informix'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of IBM Informix. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the bts_tracefile function. When parsing the trace filename, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
